title: Mount engine on a stand with an M96 adapter plate

notices.text: A generic four-arm stand will NOT bolt to an M96 — you need the bellhousing-pattern adapter plate. Use a stand rated well above the ~200 kg engine and put the stand on a solid floor; you will be applying real torque to this thing later. Mount it so the engine can rotate to put the case-half seam horizontal. Fit blanking plates/tape over every open port so nothing falls inside.
